All signs.voice_body: SENSE the pull of Venus’s return: it’s not a cosmic reset, it’s a mirror for your own values. The Sun’s opposition to Saturn adds a weighty check‑in, reminding you that charm alone won’t build lasting foundations. Use this day to audit your commitments—write down one promise you’ll keep, then act on it.
